AGENCY PARTNERSHIPS

Your client relationship.
Additional delivery capacity.

I support agencies with website design, development, landing pages, and agreed design or SEO tasks. Work can be delivered under your brand with clear responsibilities and handover requirements.

01

Start with a paid pilot.

Choose one small deliverable with acceptance criteria, a timeline, and a fixed fee. Use the pilot to assess communication and delivery before commissioning more work.

02

Keep the relationship clear.

Your agency controls client communication. Any direct involvement with your client is agreed in writing.

03

Make handover practical.

Agree the source files, assets, access, documentation, and ownership terms before work starts.

04

Plan the working rhythm.

Set review milestones, communication channels, and a suitable time-overlap window.

Agree the boundaries before work starts.

Confidentiality, revision rounds, acceptance criteria, and support responsibilities are written into the scope. Additional requests are reviewed for cost and schedule impact before work proceeds.
